title: The Inverted Dirac-Moshinsky Oscillator in $(1+1)$ Dimensions
summary: We derive and analyze the exact solutions of the inverted Dirac-Moshinsky oscillator (IDMO) in $(1+1)$ dimensions, obtained from the standard model via the substitution $p \to p + imωβx$. The upper spinor component satisfies a Weber equation with complex spectral parameter $λ= (E^2-m^2)/(2mω)+i/2$, whose solutions are parabolic cylinder functions $D_ν(ξ)$ with complex order $ν= λ- 1/2$. The physical spectrum is purely continuous ($|E|>m$), with no discrete bound states.
